name: PhotoInput
summary: Takes or picks photos on the phone, shows them as square thumbnails that open large, with a remove button outside each one. Native only.

a11y.apg: The add button and each thumbnail are buttons with a name; removing a photo says so to the screen reader.

props.name: max
props.description: How many photos; the add button goes away at the limit.

props.name: source
props.description: camera takes a photo; library picks from the gallery, several at once.

props.name: offerSettings
props.description: Offers to open the settings when the permission was denied.

props.name: onPermissionDenied
props.description: Called when the person denies the camera or the gallery.

props.name: exif
props.description: Reads the date the photo was taken (takenAt).

props.name: addIcon
props.description: The drawing of the add button.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: The drawing of the remove button.
